name: cl_fx_fvg_oside_15_short

source.title: Claude 2026-10-20 control: the open-side FVG leader, SHORT side only, against random SHORT entries (drift control for the short half)

entry.words: Above the 09:30 open only: a limit at the near edge of the most recent 15-minute up fair value gap (at least 0.1 x ATR(14) high); below the open: no trade. Stop at the middle candle's low, target 1:1. Up to two trades a day.

taught: [chat 2026-10-19] above the 09:30 open: longs on the most recent FVG; below: shorts
[chat 2026-10-19] stop at the middle candle's extreme; owner: run the same rule at 1:1
[Claude 2026-10-20, sheet cl_fvg_oside_15_mid_r1_t2_gap0p1] gaps at least 0.1 x ATR(14) high; two a day
[Claude design panel 2026-10-20] CONTROL: shorts only (dir short), so the lane adds the same-side random control (random LONGS at the same exits)
not_run: SHORTS ARE LEFT OUT ON PURPOSE: this is a control of the leader's long half, not a strategy.
THE CAP: two a day (one instance for the whole window); with no shorts, a slot a short would have used can go to a later long, so the long trades are close to, not exactly, the leader's long half.
GAP SIZE: at least 0.1 x ATR(14) of the 15-minute bars.
SIDE: price vs the 09:30 open is read on each 15-minute close, not tick by tick.
THE ENTRY: a limit at the gap's near edge; a newer gap or a flip of the side moves the order.
WINDOW: entries 09:30-15:00, an unfilled order cancelled at 15:00.
COSTS AND FILLS: the engine's own (1 tick of slippage, $4 a round turn, tick replay).
THE TEST DAYS (2025-07-01 on) ARE NOT READ: build days only.
A stop floor of 0.25 x ATR applies when the candle's extreme is nearer than that.
FLAT: every trade is flat by 15:58 ET (13:13 on half days).
